title: Quality and recording
blurb: Stereo and mono, the hold gap, ScreenAgent masks, and what QM is allowed to claim.

lessons.title: Stereo is the default
lessons.summary: Recording Management supports stereo by default and mono as well. Stereo records participants separately so analytics and one-sided playback are possible. This lesson does not invent codecs.
objectives: Leave codec lists to the media page you opened

p: Recording Management supports both stereo, by default, and mono recording. The page says stereo lets you use analytic solutions, record participants separately, and play back only one side of a call.
Questions about which mode your tenant uses go to the account representative. This lab does not publish a replacement setting.

lessons.title: Hold is a gap, not a failure
lessons.summary: Calls on hold are not recorded, including hold music. Recording resumes when the agent returns. A consultation during that hold is recorded.
objectives: Include hold music in the gap

p: When an agent puts a caller on hold, the recording stops. No audio from the hold period is captured, including hold music or anything the caller hears. Recording resumes only when the agent returns to the caller.
If the agent consults another agent or an external party during the hold, that consultation is recorded.

lessons.title: Screen masks when voice masks
lessons.summary: From ScreenAgent 2.1.40, masking a voice recording stops active screen recordings until unmask or the end. Playback shows a blank screen. Install steps stay on the Windows and Mac pages.
objectives: Not copy installers into this lesson

p: When an agent masks a recording, the screen recording stops until the interaction is unmasked or ends. Recording Management supports masking all active screen recordings when a voice recording is masked, so sensitive data is not transferred via digital channels. The page says this is available with ScreenAgent version 2.1.40 and later.
Playback of the masked part is a blank screen: the interaction is not recorded there and the sensitive data is not exposed.
ScreenAgent records and monitors screen activity. The page points at ScreenAgent for Windows and ScreenAgent for Mac for install and configuration. Those steps are not copied here.
Other recording options named on the same page are encryption, automated or on-demand pause and resume, and masking.

lessons.title: Where a recording is found
lessons.summary: Search and playback, the Contact History report, the Recording Activity report, and Cloud Storage Services are the places the page names. Column lists are not invented.
objectives: Use Recording Activity for what is being recorded

p: The page says you can search interactions to play back and download, delete recordings, see what is getting recorded with the Recording Activity report, and access recordings from the Contact History report.
Active and long-term storage is managed with Cloud Storage Services. This lesson does not copy retention numbers from a different page.
To manage recordings from a customer's third-party telephony system, the same page sends you to Engagement Hub (Multi-ACD/Open).
That is a different path from a native CXone recording. Do not debug it with only the hold-gap rule.

lessons.title: QM is real, and this lab stays inside the page
lessons.summary: Recording exists to support Quality Management. The supervisor certification names QM. This lesson does not invent evaluation forms, scores, or calibration rules.
objectives: Name QM on the supervisor badge

p: The recording overview says the product supports Quality Management processes and compliance. That is the relationship this lab will defend.

The CXone Supervisor Certification, reached through Club One, is a free foundational badge whose description covers WFM, QM, Dashboard, Coaching, and Gamification. It is not a hidden exam-code catalog.

A 26.3 release note says Quality Evaluation and Report widget export limits rise from 10,000 to 100,000 records, with one export at a time. Features on that page can change and may need a license or a public preview.
Evaluation form layout, score weights, and calibration quotas are not on the pages this lesson cites, so they are not taught.

lessons.title: Engagement Hub feeds QM from other systems
lessons.summary: Engagement Hub brings PABX, ACD, CRM, digital, and dialer data into CXone so Supervisor, Copilot for Supervisors, QM, and WFM can use it.
objectives: Name the applications the hub feeds
Separate real-time telephony from offline imports
Not treat the hub as the ACD

p: Engagement Hub connects third-party systems such as PABXs, ACDs, CRMs, digital channels, and dialers to CXone. It brings their data and events in so they can be recorded, processed, and used by Workforce Augmentation applications.
The page names Supervisor, Copilot for Supervisors, Quality Management, and Workforce Management as the applications that then share that information.

Real-time third-party telephony recording is the Multi-ACD path. Offline paths named on the page include Store and Forward, CRM Ticketing, Amazon Connect migration, and Outbound Engagement (SmartReach).
API documentation for the hub is on the developer portal, not in this lesson's clicks.

lessons.title: Playback rules you can defend
lessons.summary: A hold gap, a mask blank, and a third-party path are three different playback stories. Cloud storage is named. Retention numbers from other pages are not borrowed.
objectives: Point storage at Cloud Storage Services
Refuse a retention number this page does not give

p: Silence during hold is expected. A blank screen during a mask is expected from ScreenAgent 2.1.40. A recording that never existed in CXone because the phones are on another ACD is an Engagement Hub question.
Deleting, searching, and downloading are named as actions. The delete procedure itself is on the Interactions and Playback topic, which this lesson does not reprint.
Cloud Storage Services manages active and long-term storage. A retention period from Migrated Calls or from CRM Ticketing belongs to those features, not to every recording.
If a design needs a retention number, open the page for that feature and cite it.

steps.label: Retention
steps.detail: Only from the feature that owns it.

choices: A gap, including no hold music
